projects.title: On-device Agentic AI Assistant
projects.tech: VLMs, Ollama, MCP Servers, LangGraph, SQLite, ChromaDB
points: Designed and implemented a local, privacy-focused agentic chatbot leveraging agentic orchestration frameworks and iterative Plan-Action-Reflect loops to enable dynamic task planning, visual reasoning, and tool invocation without external dependencies.

Developed a multi-tier memory architecture for short, episodic, and long-term memory retention, integrating Spotify, Notion, Google Workspace, internal file system and web search MCP servers to extend agent capabilities while ensuring on-device execution.

projects.title: UBAssist: RAG-powered University Chatbot
projects.tech: LLMs, RAG, Cursor, Hugging Face, Docker, FAISS, LoRA, QLoRA
points: Developed an end-to-end AI chatbot using a fine-tuned Microsoft Phi 1.5 model with parameter-efficient training techniques, achieving 48% faster training and 12 percentage point improvement in answer accuracy.
Built knowledge base of 18,000+ university documents with hybrid search capabilities, enabling real-time responses while reducing incorrect answers by 30% compared to baseline models.
Deployed scalable web application using Flask, FastAPI, and Docker on cloud infrastructure, optimizing model to run efficiently with only 13M parameters while maintaining performance.

projects.title: Grayscale to RGB Image Colorization
projects.tech: CNN, UNet, Vision Transformers, GANs, Gradio
points: Built complete machine learning workflow using U-Net architecture augmented with Vision Transformer (ViT) blocks, attention gates, and patch discriminator-based adversarial training, achieving 94.15% structural similarity with ground truth images on test set of 5,000 images.
Improved model color fidelity using a weighted loss function for rare color classes and patch-level GAN loss to enforce realism and texture consistency.
Deployed as an interactive Gradio application on Hugging Face Spaces, enabling real-time image colorization with sub-second inference time.
